info.title: Toknila daemon API
info.description: Local API of the Toknila daemon. Every /v1 route needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from daemon.json.

get.summary:
The agent slots of every project and the cards waiting for one, as core's schedule computes
them.

post.summary: A person proposes a wildcard card: it waits in Proposed until a person approves or rejects it.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Return events with seq greater than this.

patch.summary:
Changes project settings. A higher parallel limit starts waiting cards at once; a lower one
never stops a running agent.

parameters.name: needs_human
parameters.description: Only tickets waiting on a person (Proposed, Waiting, Blocked, Review).

parameters.name: ticket
parameters.description: Ticket id or key, e.g. DEMO-3

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: start, pause, resume, block, unblock, accept, return, reopen, cancel, approve or reject

post.summary:
A sign of life from the ticket's agent (a hook fired). Recorded as the run's last activity;
nothing about the ticket changes.

requestBody.description: Bytes typed into the agent's terminal, as they are

200.description: Raw terminal output of the newest run, last lines only (ANSI kept). Headers x-toknila-run, x-toknila-offset (of the first byte) and x-toknila-end (after the last; continue the stream from here).

get.summary: A ticket's threads with their messages and versions, and its phase.

parameters.name: ticket
parameters.description: Ticket id or key, e.g. DEMO-3

post.summary: A person opens a thread on a ticket.

parameters.name: ticket
parameters.description: Ticket id or key, e.g. DEMO-3

post.summary: A person approves a thread; its latest version is pinned.

parameters.name: ticket
parameters.description: Ticket id or key, e.g. DEMO-3

parameters.name: thread
parameters.description: Thread number on the ticket (1, 2, ...) or thread id

post.summary: A person asks for changes: a message that keeps the thread open, or reopens it.

parameters.name: ticket
parameters.description: Ticket id or key, e.g. DEMO-3

parameters.name: thread
parameters.description: Thread number on the ticket (1, 2, ...) or thread id

post.summary: A person posts a message in a thread.

parameters.name: ticket
parameters.description: Ticket id or key, e.g. DEMO-3

parameters.name: thread
parameters.description: Thread number on the ticket (1, 2, ...) or thread id

post.summary: A person posts a new artifact version; an approved thread reopens.

parameters.name: ticket
parameters.description: Ticket id or key, e.g. DEMO-3

parameters.name: thread
parameters.description: Thread number on the ticket (1, 2, ...) or thread id

ActionInput.description: Body of ticket actions. `text` is required by block, return and cancel.

Actor.description: Who did something: a person, an agent, or the system (graph rules, autostart).

oneOf.description: The runner is up and the agent is working. Starts a Ready ticket; no-op if Running.
The agent needs a person: a question, or permission for an action.
The agent ticked a checklist item (1-based position).
A short progress report, stored as a report comment.
The agent is done; the summary becomes a report comment and the ticket goes to Review.
The agent process died.

allOf.description:
The agent found work nobody planned: a wildcard card on the ticket's chain, found during
this ticket, that waits for a person's approval. The answer is the new card.

oneOf.description:
The agent found work nobody planned: a wildcard card on the ticket's chain, found during
this ticket, that waits for a person's approval. The answer is the new card.

The agent opens a thread to settle a design, a flow or an architecture with the owner.
The hand-in is refused until every thread is approved.
A message from the agent in a thread (`thread`: its number on this ticket, or its id).
A new artifact version from the agent. A new version reopens an approved thread.

AgentEvent.description: One report from the agent working on a ticket.

AgentProfile.description:
How to launch an agent and in which role. A new agent is a new profile file, not new code.
The working directory is not part of it: the ship supplies it at launch.

command.description:
Program and arguments, never a shell string. Empty only for the simulated profile, which
starts no process: a person sends its events from the CLI.

instructions_file.description: Instructions file the agent reads, relative to its working directory.

AgentRole.description: What an agent profile is for.

ArtifactFormat.description: How an artifact body is to be read.

oneOf.description: A person blocked it by hand.
The runner process crashed.
A dependency was reopened after it had merged.
Merging into the work branch conflicted.
The daemon restarted and the runner was gone.
The ship (worktree and branch) could not be prepared.

Chain.description:
A flow of tickets with dependencies and release milestones between them. Its status,
progress and "where it stopped" are computed from tickets and releases, never stored.

autostart.description: Start Ready tickets automatically (on by default).

oneOf.description: Overrides the project's review mode for every ticket that does not set its own.

ChainDetail.description: A chain with its graph and computed status.

ChainFile.description:
A chain file: body of `POST /v1/projects/{project}/import`, answer of
`GET /v1/chains/{chain}/export`.

ChainStatus.description:
Computed chain status (never stored). Proposed wildcard cards are not part of the plan: they
do not count in `total` or `done`, but a pending decision makes the chain need a human.

ChainSummary.description: What a product person sees at a glance.

done.description: Merged, Released or Cancelled (Definition of Done: in the work branch), of `total`.

total.description: Tickets in the plan: wildcard cards count only once approved.

Comment.description:
A permanent record in a ticket: an instruction from a person, an agent's report, or a decision.
Everything said to an agent is stored here first and delivered after.

oneOf.description: When the runner delivered it to the agent; `None` while pending.

CommentBody.description: Template fields of a comment. Empty fields are `None` and are omitted when rendered.

gist.description: One-line gist, the heading of the comment.

CommentKind.description: Comment type from the template; decisions later become ADRs.

Edge.description: Dependency edge: `to` cannot start before `from` is done.

ErrorBody.description: Error body of every failed request.

code.description: Stable machine code: not_found, bad_request, conflict, ambiguous, internal, unauthorized.

EventRecord.description: One journal entry. `seq` is increasing; clients resume from it.

HookWiring.description:
How an agent reports through hooks, a second event source: the runner writes a settings file
under the data home and passes its path with `settings_flag`.

enabled.description: Whether the launcher wires hooks into this agent.

settings_flag.description: Flag of the agent's command that takes the path of a generated hook settings file.

ListedProfile.description: A profile and where it comes from.

file.description: File name in the profiles folder; `None` for a built-in profile.

McpWiring.description:
How an agent receives its MCP server (the agent event contract): the runner writes a config
file under the data home and passes its path with `config_flag`.

config_flag.description: Flag of the agent's command that takes the path of a generated MCP config.

enabled.description: Whether the launcher wires the MCP server into this agent.

MessageKind.description: Plain message, or a person's request for changes.

NewActivity.description: Body of `POST /v1/tickets/{ticket}/activity`: a sign of life from an agent's hook.

NewComment.description:
`POST /v1/tickets/{ticket}/comments`. Give `text` (first line is the gist, the rest becomes
"what") or a full `body`.

oneOf.description: Defaults to instruction.

NewProject.description: `POST /v1/projects`: a new project; unset fields take the project defaults.

key.description: Short uppercase key, prefix of ticket keys (`DEMO`).

max_parallel.description: Most agents working at once; default 2.

after.description: Nodes the milestone waits for (ticket keys or versions).

before.description: Nodes that wait for the milestone.

oneOf.description: Defaults to tag_only.
Defaults to manual.

after.description: Dependencies: ticket keys or release versions of the same chain.

message.description: A message posted with the version, in the same transaction.

from.description: The ticket during which the work was found: key, id or title.

NextRelease.description: The next milestone on the graph.

NodeRef.description: A node of the chain graph: a ticket or a release milestone.

Nudge.description: When a silent agent is nudged and how often.

idle_secs.description: Seconds without output before a nudge.

max_nudges.description: Nudges sent before the ticket is blocked.

message.default: Continue, or report with the finished event.

OutOfOrder.description: The mark of a card that was done out of order: the earlier cards that were still open.

OutputRules.description: How the terminal output of an agent is kept and shown.

max_log_bytes.description: Size at which a run's log file is rotated to `<run>.log.1`, in bytes.

scrollback_lines.description: Lines of output kept per run.

strip_ansi.description: Remove ANSI escape sequences from the text kept for search and summaries.

PatchProject.description: `PATCH /v1/projects/{project}`: the settings to change; unset fields stay.

max_parallel.description: Most agents working at once (1 to 64).

PatchTicket.description:
Fields a person may change on an existing ticket; `None` keeps the current value. Status is
not among them: it moves only through the state machine.

Phase.description:
Where a ticket is: settling its design while any thread is open, implementing otherwise.
Computed from the threads, never stored.

ProfileList.description: The profiles folder, the usable profiles and the files that were not.

ProfileProblem.description: A profile file that cannot be used. `line` and `column` are 1-based.

Project.description: One product: one monorepo, its chains, depot and settings.

max_parallel.description:
Most agents of this project that work at once (`schedule`); a card that starts beyond it
is queued.

release_branch.description: Branch that only receives tagged releases (`main`).

repo_path.description: Path to the repository on the host; empty until a repo is attached.

work_branch.description: Branch ships start from and merge into (`develop`).

ProjectAgents.description: `GET /v1/agents`: one project's agent slots and the cards waiting for one.

limit.description: Agents that may work at once.

queued.description: Waiting cards, first in line first.

used.description: Slots held now (cards Running or Waiting). Can exceed `limit` after the limit was lowered.

Proposal.description:
A wildcard card as proposed: work nobody planned, found during a ticket. References are
ticket keys, titles or release versions of the same chain.

before.description: Nodes that wait for the card; none of them may have started when it is approved.

prompt.description: The task for whoever does it.

QueuedCard.description: A card waiting for an agent slot.

Release.description: A release milestone between tickets on the chain graph.

branch.description: `release/<version>`; empty in phase 0, where there are no branches.

ReleaseEvent.description: What a release agent reports about its milestone.

ReleaseMember.description: One ticket that went into a release.

ReleaseState.description: Milestone lifecycle (gitflow): planned, then `release/<version>` is cut, then shipped.

ReviewMode.description: Who reviews a finished ticket before it merges.

Ship.description: The worktree and branch a ticket works in, once the shipyard has made them.

path.description: Absolute path of the worktree on the host.

StartMode.description: Whether the milestone cuts itself or waits for a person.

resume_to.description: Status to return to on unblock.

oneOf.description: The open question when it was blocked from Waiting, restored on unblock.
A wildcard card waits for a person to approve or reject it.

StatusReason.description: The reason attached to the current status, if that status carries one.

StoppedAt.description:
Where the chain stopped: the first ticket, in graph order, that waits on a person (Waiting or
Blocked first, then Review, then a card to approve).

Subtask.description: A checklist item inside a ticket. Subtasks have no runners of their own.

oneOf.description: Who ticked it, when done.

Thread.description: A discussion on one ticket that ends in a person's approval.

oneOf.description: When a person approved it; `None` while open.

approved_version.description: Version number the approval pinned; `None` while open, or when approved without one.

number.description: 1-based, per ticket; how people refer to it.

ThreadDetail.description: A thread with its messages and artifact versions.

ThreadKind.description: What a thread settles before the agent implements the card.

ThreadState.description: Whether the thread still needs a decision.

ThreadVersion.description: An immutable, numbered version of the thread's artifact.

Ticket.description: One unit of work for one ship.

branch.description: Ship branch `ship/<chain>/<slug>`; empty until phase 1 creates ships.

oneOf.description:
Set when the card was taken to Merged while cards before it were still open (a spec
folder whose work was done in another order). It stays after the card moves on.

needs_secrets.description: Copy depot secrets onto the ship at start.

paused.description: Paused tickets stay in Backlog and are skipped by autostart.

profile.description: Agent profile name; `None` means the project default.

prompt.description: The task given to the agent; the only source of what to do.

queued.description:
A person asked to start this Ready card; it runs as soon as a slot is free (see
`schedule`). Only a Ready card has it. Its place in the queue is computed, never stored.

oneOf.description: `None` means the chain's, then the project's review mode.
Present exactly when the status carries a reason (Waiting, Blocked, Cancelled).

Set on a wildcard card (work nobody planned): where it came from and whether a person
approved it. It stays after the decision. Absent on planned tickets.

TicketDetail.description: A ticket with everything attached to it.

phase.description: Computed from the ticket's threads: design while any is open, implement otherwise.

queue_position.description: Place in line (1 is next) while the card waits for a free agent slot; `null` otherwise.

oneOf.description:
The ticket's worktree and branch while it has them; `null` before it started, after it
merged, or when its project has no repository.

queue_position.description: Place in line (1 is next) while the card waits for a free agent slot; `null` otherwise.

TicketStatus.description: Ticket status. Transitions between them are owned by the state machine (P0-04).

TicketThreads.description: `GET /v1/tickets/{ticket}/threads`: every thread of a ticket and the ticket's phase.

Timestamp.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

oneOf.description: The agent asked a question (`ask_human`).
The agent wants permission for an action.
The agent stopped responding to nudges.

Wildcard.description:
The mark of a wildcard card: work found during the chain that waits for a person's approval
before it joins the plan.

after.description: Nodes it is to wait for; they become edges when it is approved.

approved.description: A person approved it, so it is part of the plan.

before.description: Nodes that are to wait for it; they become edges when it is approved.

oneOf.description: The ticket during which the work was found.
